prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name one single “best” lawyer for every truck accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash, the injuries, whether the truck was commercial, and whether the case will require aggressive discovery, expert witnesses, and trial work. I can, however, help you find the best lawyer for your particular situation and give you the tools to choose confidently.

Quick checklist — when you look for a Dallas truck-accident attorney, prioritize these qualifications:
- Substantial truck/ commercial vehicle experience (not just general car-accident work).
- Trial experience and a record of large verdicts/settlements in truck cases.
- Knowledge of federal/state trucking rules (FMCSA regulations, hours-of-service, ELD/black-box evidence).
- Ability to hire experienced experts (accident reconstruction, trucking operations, biomechanics, medical experts).
- Resources to handle lengthy discovery against trucking companies and insurers.
- Good client communication and responsiveness.
- Willingness to take cases on contingency and explain fees up front.

Questions to ask at an initial consultation:
- How many truck-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases against large trucking companies/insurers?
- Do you have experience obtaining and interpreting ELD/black-box and driver log data?
- Who are your usual experts and will you use them in my case?
- What is your fee structure and any anticipated costs?
- Can you provide references or past case results (verdicts/settlements)?
- How will you communicate with me and how often?

Where to verify credentials and reputation:
- State Bar of Texas attorney search (disciplinary history)
- Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers lists
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization (look for board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law)
- Local court records for verdicts/filings

If you’d like, I can:
- Compile a short, vetted list of top Dallas truck-accident attorneys or firms (with ratings and recent case results), or
- Recommend 3–5 lawyers tailored to your case now.

If you want me to search, tell me:
- Date/location of the crash (roughly)
- Severity/type of injuries
- Whether the truck was a commercial vehicle and if you know the carrier
- Any current contact from insurers or lawsuits already filed

Tell me that info and I’ll put together a tailored short-list and suggested questions to ask each attorney.
